strings.en: Welll, time to get to work.

strings.jp: 「そ～んじゃま、ちょいと行きますか」
strings.en: Alrighty then, guess I'll head on out.
Gotta make a livin' too, y'know.
Let's gooo do this, shall we?
Welll, shall we get goin'?
Y'all are just too dangerous.
Gimme just a liiittle sec here!
Gotta do my job, right?

strings.jp: 「シュウ・シラカワ……目～障りな男だよ」
strings.en: Shu Shirakawa... a real eyesore of a guy.

strings.jp: 「グランゾン……早く始末しないと」
strings.en: Granzon... Better get rid of it fast.

strings.jp: 「ま～ったく、と～んだ食わせ者だよ、シュウ」
strings.en: Maaan, you're one slippery customer, Shu.

strings.jp: 「もう、あんたにはついてけないね」
strings.en: I just can't keep up with you anymore.

strings.jp: 「お互い覚悟を決める時が来たな」
strings.en: Time for both of us to brace ourselves.

strings.jp: 「ゼゼーナン……落とし前をつける」
strings.en: Zezenan... Time you paid up.
Cybuster's miiine!
So that's the Masoukishin of wind, huh?
"The wind is calling," is it?

strings.jp: 「色んな魔装機神がいるもんだ～ね」
strings.en: Suuure are all kinds of Masoukishin, huh.

strings.jp: 「魔装機神み～たいなメカがいるから、/　地球は厄介な～んだな」
strings.en: It's mechs like the Masoukishin/　that make Earth such a paaain.
That's a real hobbyist's mech.

strings.jp: 「そ～んじゃま、ガ～ルハントと洒落こもうか」
strings.en: Welll then, time for some girl-huntin'.

strings.jp: 「ヒュッケバインって、/　消～えたはずじゃなかったか？」
strings.en: Hückebein? Wasn't that thing/　suppooosed to be gone?

strings.jp: 「あれ、問題が多いからね。消してやるよ」
strings.en: That thing's trouble. I'll wipe it out.
Looks pretty beat-uuup.
I'll craaack those glasses of yours.

strings.jp: 「ボ～ロボロの次は、トゲトゲか」
strings.en: Beat-uuup, and now spiky, huh?

strings.jp: 「別の星の技術を使ってる奴も、厄介だ～ね」
strings.en: Guys usin' alien tech are a paaain too.

strings.jp: 「見～た目のハッタリは凄いな」
strings.en: Loooks impressive, anyway.
Gotta get rid of the Double G.

strings.jp: 「ダブルＧを倒せば、/　あいつらも意気消沈す～るだろ」
strings.en: Beat the Double G, and that'll/　take the wind outta their sails, I bet.
That sword looks reeeal heavy.

strings.jp: 「さ～て、グルンガストをさく～っと倒すか」
strings.en: Welll, let's zip through this Grungust.

strings.jp: 「グ～ルンと回って、ガスッと変形する奴ね」
strings.en: The one that spins with a grrrun and/　transforms with a gust, huh?

strings.jp: 「あ～んなのが量産されたら、あいつらは/　攻め込んでくる。今の内に始末しなきゃな」
strings.en: If they mass-produce stuff like thaaat,/　they'll invade. Gotta take it out now.

strings.jp: 「派手なメカだね。誰が作ったんだか」
strings.en: Flashy mech. Who built that thing?
Lookin' real slick, in a lotta ways.

strings.jp: 「昔からあ～ゆ～のを作ってるから、/　地球人は危険なんだな」
strings.en: Earthlings are dangerous 'cause they've/　been buildin' stuff like thaaat forever.
My turn now.
Welll then, payback time.

strings.jp: 「こ～っちのも見てってちょうだいよ」
strings.en: Have a looook at mine too, won'tcha?
No use tryin' to ruuun.
Then I'll go first next.
Here's where the real show staaarts.
Give aaand take, right?
W-well, would ya look at that!

strings.jp: 「あ～りゃま、やぁられちまったい！」
strings.en: Whoooa, they got me!
Th-this is waaay too much!

strings.jp: 「まぁいった、まいった。出直してくるわ」
strings.en: Weeell, I give. I'll come back later.

strings.jp: 「こ～のまま終わるつもりはな～いんだよね」
strings.en: Don't plan on endin' it like thiiis, though.

strings.jp: 「くうっ！　さぁすが、やるやる」
strings.en: Ngh! Not bad, not bad at all.

strings.jp: 「おおっ？　ちょ～いとまずいかもね」
strings.en: Whoa? Might be a liiittle trouble.

strings.jp: 「おおっとお！　洒落になんなくなってきたかな」
strings.en: Whoa there! This ain't funny anymore.
Nghh! That stuuung...

strings.jp: 「おっとっと、オーグバリューでも危ないな」
strings.en: Whoops, even the Org-Valu's at risk.

strings.jp: 「つうう……！　魔装機神、侮れないね」
strings.en: Ow...! Masoukishin are no joke.

strings.jp: 「くうう……/　ヒュッケバインを超えるって～の？」
strings.en: Ngh.../　You sayin' it beats a Hückebein?

strings.jp: 「いてて……ガスッとやられちまったい」
strings.en: Ow ow... That one hit with a gust.

strings.jp: 「おおっ！　バリバリだ～ね、そのマシン」
strings.en: Whoa! That machine's got some kick!

strings.jp: 「グランゾン……や～っぱ始末に悪いわ」
strings.en: Granzon... a reeeal pain to deal with.

strings.jp: 「お～嬢ちゃん相手に、/　ボケてる場合じゃないかもね」
strings.en: No time to be goofin' around/　with a little missy, maybe.
Heyyy, not bad at all.

strings.jp: 「う～ん、まあまあってと～ころかね」
strings.en: Hmm, I'd call that so-so.
Huh, you've got some pretty good skills.
Ow-ow-ow, that one landed.
Whoa, that rattled me. Rattled me good.

strings.jp: 「オーグバリューは、ま～だまだ大丈夫よ」
strings.en: The Org-Valu can still take plenty.
Not bad at all, Cybuster.

strings.jp: 「こ～っちが消えるわけには/　い～かないんだよね」
strings.en: Can't have me disappearing,/　not just yet, y'know.

strings.jp: 「ほ～う、グルンガスト……な～かなか」
strings.en: Ohh, the Grungust... not bad at all.
Ooh, that one really zapped me.

strings.jp: 「バラン＝シュナイル……性能はさ～すがね」
strings.en: Baran-Schneil... impressive specs.
That's the Granzon for ya.

strings.jp: 「ぼ～ちぼちでんな、お嬢ちゃん」
strings.en: Can't complain, little lady.
Hmm? Did somethin' hit me?
Well, well, is that all?
No good, no good./　That's not even worth a mention.
You just barely hit me, huh?
Barely felt that.

strings.jp: 「こ～う見えて、/　オーグバリューは丈夫なんだな」
strings.en: Doesn't look it, but/　the Org-Valu's a tough one.

strings.jp: 「大したことないね、サイバスター」
strings.en: Not much to you, Cybuster.

strings.jp: 「ヒュッケバインがあ～の世で泣いてるよ」
strings.en: The Hückebein's crying in its grave.

strings.jp: 「しょ～ぼいね、グルンガストも」
strings.en: The Grungust's pretty lame too, huh.
Real flashy colors, though.

strings.jp: 「グランゾンって、そ～んなもん？」
strings.en: That's all the Granzon's got?

strings.jp: 「突っ込みが弱いね、お嬢ちゃん」
strings.en: Weak comeback, little lady.

strings.jp: 「案外や～るじゃないの、あのおっさん」
strings.en: That old guy's better than I thought.
Hup, and away.

strings.jp: 「そ～こじゃないでしょ。/　俺はこ～っちよ、こっち」
strings.en: Wrong way./　I'm over here, over here.
Mi-issed.
Can't hit me, funny thing.
Too bad.

strings.jp: 「あ～んたにそのマシンは上手く扱えないさ」
strings.en: You can't handle that machine worth a darn.

strings.jp: 「付～け焼き刃だね、ゼゼーナン」
strings.en: All veneer, no skill, Zezenan.
Ah, that sorta thing's useless, useless.
Doesn't work on me, funny thing.
I've got defenses for this sorta thing.
Oh dear, what a mess.
Hmm, I blew that one.
Well, this is a pickle.
Sure are good at runnin' away.
Ah well, can't be helped.

strings.jp: 「ま、そ～の内にまた出てくるでしょ」
strings.en: Eh, they'll show up again sooner or later.
Don't mind if I take the best part.

strings.jp: 「お～っと、まだ俺がいるんだな」
strings.en: Whoa there, you've still got me to deal with.

strings.jp: 「手伝ってやるよ、ロフちゃん」
strings.en: I'll give you a hand, Rof, pal.
Sety, I'm up next.

strings.jp: 「メキちゃん、優しいな～。/　手柄を譲ってくれるなんて」
strings.en: Meki, so sweet of ya./　Lettin' me have the credit.
Might as well rack up some points.
Not gonna happen.
Can't let this kinda thing slide.
Rof, pal, what're you doin'?
Sety, this isn't like you.

strings.jp: 「も～う、メキちゃんてば。しょうがないな」
strings.en: Geez, Meki. You're hopeless.

strings.jp: 「ま、上官を守るのも仕事の内」
strings.en: Hey, guarding the boss is part of the job.
Ooh, can I go again?
Time to Attack Again.
If this drops 'em... Lucky!
How's this, then?
Take this.
Guess that'll do.
Here ya go, here ya go.
Heeere goes, I'm gonna slice ya.
Sorry, but you're goin' dooown.
Ooh, riiight on the spot!
Hey-o, right there.

strings.jp: 「ドライバーキャノン、そ～らよっ！」
strings.en: Driver Cannon, here ya gooo!
Pinpoint shot!
Heeere's the Driver Cannon!
How 'bout a taaaste of this?
Okaaay, let's go out with a bang.

strings.jp: 「ほ～れっ！　ギガブラスター！」
strings.en: Here ya go! Giga Blaster!
This one's gonna stiiing.

strings.jp: 「ギガブラスター！　そ～れっ！」
strings.en: Giga Blaster! Heeere goes!
Got ya riiight in my sights.
Don't mind if I dooo!

strings.jp: 「こ～れで終わりなんだな！　悪いけど！」
strings.en: This is the end of the liiine! Sorry!
Barrel, seeet!
Miiine now!
Here ya go, here ya go!
This thing is fast.
Heeere goes, get 'em!
Welp, shall we wrap this up?
No blocking this one!
Heeere's the Gain Shooter!

strings.jp: 「こ～れ、オーグバリューの決め技でね」
strings.en: This here's the Org-Valu's finisher.
Alriiight, let's make it flashy!

strings.jp: 「ゲインシューター！　く～らいなよ！」
strings.en: Gain Shooter! Take thaaat!

strings.jp: 「も～う逃げられない！　潰れろって！」
strings.en: No escaaape now! Just get crushed!
